title: Polish dashboards and add linked task dependencies
description: Logos, light/dark themes for both apps; clean task headers; persistent Kanban default; status ordering; structured dependency links.

notes.text: Implemented clean SVG logos/favicons, system/light/dark persistence, neutral white/charcoal bridge with official Rust/TypeScript icons, default persisted Kanban, active-first status/time order, distinct status badges, compact detail header, notes count and inline add-subtask. Added dependencyIds/dependencies.set in shared core with same-checkout ref resolution, cycle rejection and concurrency lock; linked both directions in UI and migrated quoted companion task. SDS: 30 tests/256 assertions and build pass; shared bridge TypeScript diagnostics fresh/clean. Bridge: 6 unit tests, release build and Clippy pass. Both servers refreshed; three workspaces retained and demo disconnected. Browser verified themes, hierarchy persistence and dependency navigation. No graph view added; linked lists keep the page compact.
